en.text: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

footnotes.text: 1:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华从会幕中呼叫摩西，对他说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華從會幕中呼叫摩西，對他說：

en.text: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

zhSimplified.text: 「你晓谕以色列人说：你们中间若有人献供物给耶和华，要从牛群羊群中献牲畜为供物。

zhTraditional.text: 「你曉諭以色列人說：你們中間若有人獻供物給耶和華，要從牛群羊群中獻牲畜為供物。

en.text: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 「他的供物若以牛为燔祭，就要在会幕门口献一只没有残疾的公牛，可以在耶和华面前蒙悦纳。

zhTraditional.text: 「他的供物若以牛為燔祭，就要在會幕門口獻一隻沒有殘疾的公牛，可以在耶和華面前蒙悅納。

en.text: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

zhSimplified.text: 他要按手在燔祭牲的头上，燔祭便蒙悦纳，为他赎罪。

zhTraditional.text: 他要按手在燔祭牲的頭上，燔祭便蒙悅納，為他贖罪。

en.text: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

zhSimplified.text: 他要在耶和华面前宰公牛；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要奉上血，把血洒在会幕门口、坛的周围。

zhTraditional.text: 他要在耶和華面前宰公牛；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要奉上血，把血灑在會幕門口、壇的周圍。

en.text: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

zhSimplified.text: 那人要剥去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成块子。

zhTraditional.text: 那人要剝去燔祭牲的皮，把燔祭牲切成塊子。

en.text: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

zhSimplified.text: 祭司亚伦的子孙要把火放在坛上，把柴摆在火上。

zhTraditional.text: 祭司亞倫的子孫要把火放在壇上，把柴擺在火上。

en.text: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

zhSimplified.text: 亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把肉块和头并脂油摆在坛上火的柴上。

zhTraditional.text: 亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把肉塊和頭並脂油擺在壇上火的柴上。

en.text: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 但燔祭的脏腑与腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全烧在坛上，当作燔祭，献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 但燔祭的臟腑與腿要用水洗。祭司就要把一切全燒在壇上，當作燔祭，獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。

en.text: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

zhSimplified.text: 「人的供物若以绵羊或山羊为燔祭，就要献上没有残疾的公羊。

zhTraditional.text: 「人的供物若以綿羊或山羊為燔祭，就要獻上沒有殘疾的公羊。

en.text: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

zhSimplified.text: 要把羊宰于坛的北边，在耶和华面前；亚伦子孙作祭司的，要把羊血洒在坛的周围。

zhTraditional.text: 要把羊宰於壇的北邊，在耶和華面前；亞倫子孫作祭司的，要把羊血灑在壇的周圍。

en.text: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

zhSimplified.text: 要把燔祭牲切成块子，连头和脂油，祭司就要摆在坛上火的柴上；

zhTraditional.text: 要把燔祭牲切成塊子，連頭和脂油，祭司就要擺在壇上火的柴上；

en.text: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 但脏腑与腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉献，烧在坛上。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。

zhTraditional.text: 但臟腑與腿要用水洗，祭司就要全然奉獻，燒在壇上。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。

en.text: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

zhSimplified.text: 「人奉给耶和华的供物，若以鸟为燔祭，就要献斑鸠或是雏鸽为供物。

zhTraditional.text: 「人奉給耶和華的供物，若以鳥為燔祭，就要獻斑鳩或是雛鴿為供物。

en.text: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

zhSimplified.text: 祭司要把鸟拿到坛前，揪下头来，把鸟烧在坛上；鸟的血要流在坛的旁边；

zhTraditional.text: 祭司要把鳥拿到壇前，揪下頭來，把鳥燒在壇上；鳥的血要流在壇的旁邊；

en.text: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

zhSimplified.text: 又要把鸟的嗉子和脏物除掉，丢在坛的东边倒灰的地方。

zhTraditional.text: 又要把鳥的嗉子和髒物除掉，丟在壇的東邊倒灰的地方。

en.text: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 要拿着鸟的两个翅膀，把鸟撕开，只是不可撕断；祭司要在坛上、在火的柴上焚烧。这是燔祭，是献与耶和华为馨香的火祭。」

zhTraditional.text: 要拿着鳥的兩個翅膀，把鳥撕開，只是不可撕斷；祭司要在壇上、在火的柴上焚燒。這是燔祭，是獻與耶和華為馨香的火祭。」
